query: Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool repair status latest news June July 2026, algae paint peeling, is the pool fully repaired, lawsuit status
answer:
Research complete. Here is a summary of the key findings on the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool repair status:

**Is the pool fully repaired?** No. As of mid-to-late July 2026, it remains unfinished, having been drained at least three times since May amid recurring algae blooms and peeling of the new "American flag blue" coating. On July 14, Trump said it would be "refilled and put back into service soon," but no confirmed reopening date was announced.

**Algae & paint peeling:** Algae turned the water green shortly after the June refill (still green as of July 10). The blue coating began peeling within two weeks of completion. Four waterproofing experts told the Washington Post (July 16) the peeling resulted from **application errors — a botched repair, not vandalism** — contradicting the administration's vandalism claims.

**Vandalism vs. repair dispute:** Trump/Burgum blame vandals cutting the liner with knives/razors; NPS reported seven arrests, seven citations, 18 police reports, and DOJ charged at least four people (including former Olympic canoeist David Hearn, who pleaded not guilty). An FBI Evidence Response Team was on site July 15.

**Cost/contractors:** ~$16M total via two no-bid contracts — ~$14.7M to Atlantic Industrial Coatings (also awarded the repairs) and $1.7M to Green Water Solutions.

**Lawsuit status:** *Cultural Landscape Foundation v. DOI* (Case 1:26-cv-01593, D.D.C., Judge Carl Nichols), filed May 11, 2026, alleges NHPA Section 106 and NEPA violations. TCLF sought a TRO/preliminary injunction; no confirmed final ruling was found — the case appeared pending while work continued.
